name: Hang glider
definition: unpowered, foot-launched glider with a rigid frame under a fabric wing, steered by the pilot's weight shift.
notes: Sold as ready-to-fly hang gliders in families Alpha, Falcon 4, Sport 3

name: Paraglider
definition: unpowered, foot-launched glider with a flexible ram-air fabric wing hung on suspension lines; a powered paraglider is G1.
notes: Paragliders sold as a category (137 results), incl. paramotor tandem wing (Gin Condor)

name: Free-flight harness
definition: harness that suspends and carries the pilot under a hang glider or paraglider.
notes: Harnesses sold as own category; Ozone groups open, reversible, pod, sub, tandem

name: Traction kite

notes: Traction kites sold for buggy, mountainboard, snowkite; Peter Lynn Twister described as land traction wing

name: Parachute
